geometryCorrection.notes: Four confirmed exterior gable gaps are closed. Boundary walls split at dominant roof-plane crossings; triangular peaks and original timber studs are filled. Dormers remain on sloping eaves with closed outward-facing shells. The skyline preserves the turret footprint and simplifies subpixel roof collars/spire-tip segments to stay at1000 triangles. A durable regression checks24 rays across source, import and four tiers. Existing map, frame, materials, terrain and scope are retained.

notes: All 12 final portable views inspected. The complete principal castle includes both mapped parents, all connected main and returned ranges, one open western court, a real through-gateway, the square clock tower with open side arches and closed clock panels, its steep roof/open lantern/spire, a separate polygonal timber tower and two white turrets. Gray slate gables and hips carry closed dormer shells and chimneys; the central glass roof is closed. Original timber framing and plain plaster replace figurative ornament. The front veranda has six stone supports, closed rear glazing and a continuous buried plinth. Deep foundations are deliberately exposed in isolated turntable views. Three ordinary front, court-corner and oblique aerial pictures were inspected. Rear and roof inventories, concealed joins, original clock and gable trim, window rhythm, timber patterns, terrace shapes and historic grades are medium-fi approximations. Lower garden works and independent estate structures are outside the principal-building scope. Context is synthetic; physical device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four exact authored tiers within 1000/4000/16000/64000 triangles, at most seven draws, zero images and separate GPU streams. The detailed source stays separate. Skyline simplifies small contours, lantern posts and approaches; district uses window proxies and timber bands. Street has closed recesses; close-up adds timber braces and roof trim. Tests verify the actual open court and gateway, two open clock-gallery sightlines, closed clock panels and tower caps, returned roofs, closed glass roof, buried veranda support, native approach contact, production replacement/retention and exact tier reconstruction. Twenty-four new rays verify all four former gable gaps across the detailed source, import and four runtime tiers. Skyline tolerates its declared contour simplification. External layout bytes have an explicit SHA256 pin. Error estimates and physical timings remain unmeasured.
